_about: Made-up contracts, one per shape the contract-terms audit of 2026-10-04 found in real vendor contracts (data/contracts/terms-audit-2026-10-04.md). Every name, address, and number is fake. 'expect' holds what the reader should give now, for the fixes already made (duplicates, 'will', we/you, initials, counterparty_name, bullets, licenses). 'open' holds what a later fix should give (checked options, noise, topic phrases, exemptions, discretion, incorporated standards, passive 'will be', aliases and role labels); move a row from 'open' to 'expect' when its fix lands. A 'contains' is a substring of a term's quote, matched case-insensitively after collapsing whitespace.

01_monitoring_second_person.txt.shape: A vendor's form in the second person, no definition of we/you; the whole contract twice (copy and signed copy) then a DocuSign certificate page; a license printed as 'C10 600001' in the letterhead; checkboxes in the header.

terms.contains: We will provide the services described above
You must pay the prorated fees
You will not tamper with
We will provide you a written inspection report within ten (10) days

deliverables: written inspection report within ten (10) days

exemptions: We are not responsible for any loss caused by the failure of the System
We will not be obligated to repair any part of the System

discretion.contains: We may increase the monthly service charge at any time

incorporated.contains: meet the minimum requirements of NFPA 72

passive_will.contains: will be performed to meet the minimum requirements

02_sprinkler_proposal_bullets.txt.shape: A proposal on letterhead with 'o' bullets on their own lines, the vendor abbreviated to initials (T.E.F.S.C.) with no definition, an incorporated standard, an exclusions list, option lines with the X marks extracted later in the text, and an Adobe Sign audit trail.

terms.contains: T.E.F.S.C. shall utilize the new Inspection Testing & Maintenance Reports
Inspection reports shall be filled out
Customer shall provide complete and total uninterrupted access
Customer shall place system in test with their monitoring company

separate_terms: Systems must be free from deficiencies prior to the placement of said

checked_options.note: The two X marks belong to the Annual and Quarterly lines only by their position on the page (same y); from text alone the reader should say 'options not read', never guess.

passive.contains: System(s) shall be inspected in strict accordance

03_roof_repair_letterhead.txt.shape: A letterhead contract (no 'by and between'), a dba with a parenthetical alias (EHS), a customer block (Bill To, c/o) that is not the counterparty, an arbitration provider that is not the counterparty, dash bullets of imperative scope, passive 'will be', page footers, and statutory notices (mechanics lien, CSLB).

scope_items: Replace approximately 12 linear feet of flashing

passive_will.contains: Debris will be removed from the site

statutory_notice: Under the California Mechanics' Lien Law
CSLB is the state consumer protection agency

prohibition.contains: Work will not be conducted during weekends

alias_terms.contains: will complete the scope of work as listed above
EHS will provide a written warranty of five (5) years

04_management_agreement.txt.shape: A management agreement with defined parties ('the "Association"', 'hereinafter "MANAGER"'), a page footer inside a sentence, an exemption written as 'shall not be obligated', a disclaimer, an effort standard, sole discretion over fees, and termination for any reason.

terms.contains: Manager shall prepare and deliver to the Board monthly financial statements within fifteen (15) days
Manager, will deliver services reasonably necessary
Association shall pay Manager a monthly fee of $1,500

deliverables: monthly financial statements within fifteen (15) days
draft agenda for each regular meeting
deliver all records to the Association within thirty (30) days

exemptions: Manager shall not be obligated to attend meetings on weekends
Manager is specifically not responsible for the quality of work
not_prohibition: Manager shall not be obligated to attend meetings

discretion.contains: Manager may adjust the fees in its sole discretion
Either party may terminate this Agreement for any reason

effort_standard.contains: Manager will endeavor to make helpful suggestions
